focus: mimo-06: Validation triage, routing clarify and defer, operator friction

label: By my own grep the canary gold is 62 route, 10 defer, 9 reject plus 3 clarify rows across seven hubs, so clarify and defer claims have 13 rows of gold in total

Gate 3 has the highest operator reach and the only real gold (195 labeled prompts at F1 0.9843), but the question it guards is session-wide operator policy and the arm drops as product, keeping the corpus as a negative control
The completion sentinel check budgets 1200 ms under a 1.5 s bound, so every done-gate arm is offline or async and no product build adds per-turn cost
The completion claim regex fires on generic words including occurred and happened with a 400-char anchor tail, the exact false-fire surface a Jev noul would pre-answer
One 30 to 50 excerpt labeled set serves both the goal verifier and the done gate because met/not-met/unclear and claims-completion classes are the same turns read two ways
The clarify suggested default is the purest decision-removing surface but waits on a 30-plus-row gold build and a clarify-rate measurement, with no telemetry of reach found today
